text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't stop me, Air Groove-san! At this 
rate... Tracen Academy will be ruined!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Stop jumping to conclusions. It is 
merely a fallen tree caused by the wind 
and rain. I have already contacted 
contractors for removal—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But—it's disrupting the qi of the entire 
academy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Keeping the entrance clean is the basics 
of feng shui. And the school gate is 
Tracen Academy's entrance!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Dragon Vein—the lucky zone—flows in 
from the entrance and spreads through the 
whole place. So right now, our fortune has 
been cut off!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even supposing what you say is correct. 
The contractors will arrive tomorrow. 
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...This is the worst bad landform qi I've 
ever seen. If we leave it until 
tomorrow... who knows what might...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's why—!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I get a running start, just like 
kicking down a fence, I should be able to 
kick that fallen tree away...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Here I go~! Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: MEGA GOOD FORTUUUUUNE!!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't jump in front of me all of a 
sudden! That's dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool! You are the one in danger...!! What 
would you have done if you got injured?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* ...I see there is no stopping you. 
...Let us find people on campus who can 
assist.
choice_data_list: I'll go gather people to help too!
I'll go gather people to help too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san, Trainer too...! Thank 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone! We move it on the count 
of 'Fire, Earth, Metal, Water, Mega 
Fortune!' Fire, Earth, Metal, Water—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, does it really have to be on that 
cue?! ...Ugh, whatever! Heave!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: —MEGA FORTUNE~! —M-MEGA FORTUNE~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—...And so, with the assistance of this 
trainer here, we managed to remove the 
fallen tree.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. So Tracen Academy was saved, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Surely that is an exaggeration. Though we 
had received complaints about the path 
being blocked by the tree...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
... What do you think was ahead on that 
blocked path?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As it happens, since the tree was cleared, 
the track maintenance crew came a day 
earlier than scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Upon inspection, sharp debris was found 
scattered among the woodchips on the 
uphill slope. Likely blown in by the 
storm. In other words—
choice_data_list: I-If we hadn't moved that fallen tree...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The inspection would have been 
delayed, and students might have gotten 
injured.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's definitely giving me way too 
much credit!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I do this kind of thing all the time 
anyway. No need to make such a big deal 
out of it... right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Find the un-lucky★ and turn it into 
lucky☆! Anyone can do it if they just 
study feng shui properly.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me! It's about time I 
checked the qi in my room. See ya!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
'All the time', she says. It seems her 
desire for everyone's happiness is the 
genuine article.

—Before anyone realized, the sky had 
cleared, revealing a brilliant blue sky 
that seemed to promise happiness for all.
